learning_outcomes.text: Understand data properties, analytical methods, and correctly interpret results. Present and visualize these methods.

syllabus_topics: Data and their Properties
Statistical Data Features

Extending of Linear Model
Data Transformation
Optimization methods
Data Vizualization
